title: Bluetooth Scan Issue when using 2 versions of XDRIP
body:
Hi there, I have a problem whereby I have 2 diabetics in our house. I am running xdrip on 2 phones.

When I try to scan for the bluetooth device on iether phone, you have to turn off the other phone before the MiaoMiao will display, its like there is a clash where the other version of xdrip blocks the miaomiao from being seen. (I did have 2 versions on 1 phone (1 as a follower, and one as a variant, but also had the similar issue, so tried in on a seperate phone and have the same issue). 

This causes an issue when we add a smartwatch as a collector, as the xdrip fails to reconnect to the phone when back in range as it cannot see the bluetooth device.

Is there a way around this ?

comments.body:
Yes, there is a way around this.

miaomiao can not connect to two devices, not much that we can do about it.
But what we can do, is to have one xdrip (or both) also upload the data to a mongo device.
Once this is done, you can have the main xdrip read the data from BT and the mongo, and as such, it will always be able to have the correct values.

I'll create instructions on how to do it, hopefully tonight.

Here is how to connect the two phones (or phone with watch)
1) open an account on mlab.com, and create a free db.
2) on the watch, go to settings->cloud upload->mongo db
   a) enable nightscout.
   b) enter the mongodb uri
   c) enable "upload libre transmitter data"
you can now watch that data received by this watch is uploaded to the mongo db to a collection called libre.

To read the data by the main phone do the following (the main phone):

On hw data source select ‘libre wifi’ or ‘libre bluetooth + wifi’
On the list of receivers, enter the list of raspberry pis and / or the mongodb addresses. For example:
192.168.1.2:50005,mongodb://user:pass@ds11551.mlab.com:11551/nightscout3/libre
Replace nightscout3 with your connection.
